description: Play the Executioners Guild if you want to strike down your targets with lethal precision.

foundation.name: First Strike
foundation.text: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack, you deal double damage.

foundation.name: Ambush
foundation.text: Your "Marked for Death" feature uses **d6s** instead of d4s.

mastery.name: True Strike
mastery.text: Once per long rest when you fail an attack, you can **spend a Hope** to make it a success instead.

mastery.name: Backstab
mastery.text: Your "Marked for Death" feature uses **d8s** instead of d6s.

name: Executioners Guild

specialization.name: Death Strike
specialization.text: When you deal Severe damage to a creature, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to mark an additional Hit Point.

specialization.name: Scorpion's Poise
specialization.text: You gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against attacks made by a creature you've _Marked for_ _Death_.

description: Play the Poisoners Guild if you want to debilitate your targets with punishing afflictions.

foundation.name: Toxic Concoctions
foundation.text:
**Mark a Stress** to place **1d4+1** tokens on this card. When you make a successful weapon attack, you can spend a token to afflict the target with a poison. You know these poisons:

- _Ghost Petal:_ The target becomes temporarily _Vulnerable_.
- _Grave Spore:_ The target must also mark a Stress.
- _Leech Weed:_ You deal an extra **1d6** damage on this attack.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

mastery.name: Venomancer
mastery.text:
You also know these poisons:

- _Blight Seed:_ The target gains a -3 penalty to their damage thresholds until the end of the scene. This effect can't stack.
- _Fear Leaf:_ You deal extra damage equal to the result of your Fear Die on this attack.
- _Corpse Thorn:_ The target gains disadvantage on reaction rolls until the end of the scene.

mastery.name: Adder's Blessing
mastery.text: You are immune to poisons and other toxins.

name: Poisoners Guild

specialization.name: Poison Compendium
specialization.text:
You also know these poisons:

- _Midnight Vine:_ The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until it marks a Stress to clear this condition.
- _Gorgon Root:_ The target becomes temporarily _Restrained_.

specialization.name: Twin Fang
specialization.text: When you afflict a target _Marked for Death_ with a poison you know, you can spend an additional token to also inflict the effect of a second poison you know.

description: Play the Juggernaut if you want to pulverize your opponents with crushing blows.

foundation.name: Rugged
foundation.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

foundation.name: Overwhelm
foundation.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target, you can **spend a Hope** to throw the target within Close range or to force them to mark a Stress.

mastery.name: Pummeljoy
mastery.text: When you critically succeed on a Melee weapon attack, you gain an additional Hope, clear an additional Stress, and gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for that attack.

mastery.name: Not Done Yet
mastery.text: When you take Severe damage, you can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

name: Juggernaut

specialization.name: Surrounded
specialization.text: When you make an attack with a Melee weapon, you can **spend any number of Hope** to target an equal number of additional creatures within Melee range.

specialization.name: Eye for an Eye
specialization.text: Once per rest when an adversary within Melee range forces you to mark any number of Hit Points, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to mark the same number of Hit Points.

description: Play the Martial Artist if you want to use a variety of fighting styles to eliminate your foes.

foundation.name: Stance Fighter
foundation.text:
You can channel your inner resolve to shift into martial stances that grant you special benefits in combat.

Take the Martial Stances sheet and choose two martial stances from Tier 1. Each time you level up your character, choose an additional stance from your tier or lower.

mastery.name: Limit Breaker
mastery.text: Once per rest, you can perform an unbelievable feat of athletic prowess, such as running across water, leaping between distant rooftops, or scaling a building without needing to roll. When you do, gain a Hope and clear a Stress.

mastery.name: Flow State
mastery.text: You can **mark a Stress** instead of spending a Focus to shift into a different stance. Additionally, you can **spend a Focus** instead of marking a Stress to start a combo strike.

name: Martial Artist

specialization.name: Keen Defenses
specialization.text: When you're targeted by an attack, you can **spend a Focus** to gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to your tier against the attack.

specialization.name: Focus Cannon
specialization.text: **Spend a Focus** to make an Instinct Roll against an adversary within Far range. On a success, deal **d20+3** magic damage using your Proficiency.

description: Play the Pact of the Endless if you want to stand strong against enemies and avoid death.

foundation.name: Patron's Mantle
foundation.text: **Spend a Favor** to cloak yourself in a terrifying aspect of your Patron that lasts until you take Severe damage or the scene ends. While this effect is active, you gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier and have advantage on action rolls to intimidate a target.

foundation.name: Deathless Embrace
foundation.text: Once per rest, **spend any number of Favor** to roll an equal number of Patron Dice. For each result of 4 or higher, clear a Hit Point.

mastery.name: Dark Aegis
mastery.text: Once per long rest when you would take damage, you can **spend a Favor** instead of marking Hit Points.

mastery.name: Draining Bane
mastery.text: When an adversary targets you or an ally within Very Close range with an attack, you can **spend a Favor** to _Drain_ them. When you do, they must mark a Stress, and you can clear a Stress. While _Drained_, the target uses a **d12** instead of a d20 for attack rolls (including for advantage or disadvantage) until they fail a roll.

name: Pact of the Endless

specialization.name: Harrowing Invocation
specialization.text: When an adversary targets you or an ally within Very Close range with an attack, you can **spend a Favor** to give them disadvantage on the roll. If the adversary fails the roll, they must also mark a Stress.

specialization.name: Damage Sink
specialization.text: Once per rest, you can **spend a Favor** to halve incoming damage.

description: Play the Pact of the Wrathful if you want to destroy those who act against you.

foundation.name: Patron's Fury
foundation.text: **Spend a Favor** to imbue your attacks with your Patron's power until you deal Severe damage or the scene ends. When you roll damage while this effect is active, you also roll a number of Patron Dice equal to your tier and add their total to the damage dealt.

foundation.name: Deadly Vengeance
foundation.text: When you mark any number of Hit Points from an attack, you can **spend a Favor** to roll an equal number of Patron Dice. For each result of 4 or higher, the attacker marks a Hit Point.

mastery.name: Fearsome Attack
mastery.text: **Spend a Favor** to reroll any number of your damage dice. You can continue spending Favor to use this feature on the same damage roll.

mastery.name: Otherworldly Ire
mastery.text: Once per rest when you take damage, you can **spend any number of Favor** to roll that many Patron Dice and target a number of creatures within Close range equal to the highest result. Each target must mark a Hit Point.

name: Pact of the Wrathful

specialization.name: Menacing Reach
specialization.text: **Spend a Favor** to increase the range of your primary weapon by one step (such as Melee to Very Close or Very Close to Close) to a maximum of Very Far range. This effect ends when you make a successful attack with that weapon.

specialization.name: Diminish My Foes
specialization.text: When you succeed with Hope on an action roll against a target, you can **spend any number of Favor** to force the target to mark an equal number of Stress.

description: Play the Hedge Witch if you want to use your craft to empower yourself and your party.

foundation.name: Herbal Remedies
foundation.text: When you or an ally in the scene clears 1 or more Hit Points or Stress as the result of using a consumable, increase the number cleared by 1.

foundation.name: Enchanted Talisman
foundation.text: Once per rest, you can imbue a small item with your protective essence. **Spend any number of Hope** to place an equal number of tokens on this card. When the person holding the talisman takes damage, spend a token to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by one. Clear all tokens from this card when you take a rest.

mastery.name: Circle of Power
mastery.text: Once per rest, mark a circle on the ground outlining a Very Close area around you, and place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. While within this circle, you and your allies gain a +2 bonus to damage thresholds, attack rolls, and Evasion. Remove a token each time you or an ally within the circle makes an action roll or evades an attack. This spell lasts until the last token is removed or you exit the circle.

name: Hedge Witch

specialization.name: Walk Between Worlds
specialization.text: During a moment of calm, make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. Once per rest on a success, you can **mark a Stress** to step beyond the veil of death and converse with any nearby spirits. Place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card and remove one each time a spirit answers a question. When the last token is removed or at the end of the scene, you return to the Mortal Realm in the same spot you left it.

specialization.name: Vexing Malison
specialization.text: You have advantage on attacks against _Hexed_ creatures.

description: Play the Moon Witch if you want to embody celestial power to amplify your magic.

foundation.name: Night's Glamour
foundation.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)** to _Glamour_ yourself in a bewitching facade. While _Glamoured_, you have advantage on rolls that leverage your illusory appearance. Additionally, adversaries within Close range must mark a Stress to attack you.

Unless you **mark a Stress** to maintain your _Glamour_, it drops when you mark a Hit Point or deal damage.

mastery.name: Lunar Phases
mastery.text:
At the beginning of each session, roll a **d6** and place it on this card. You gain the matching effect until the end of session.

| Roll | Phase | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1** | New | **Spend a Hope** to negate Minor damage. |
| **2-3** | Waxing | +2 to damage rolls |
| **4** | Full | +3 to damage thresholds |
| **5-6** | Waning | +1 to Evasion |

Once per rest, you can **spend a Hope** to increase the value of this die by one. If you increase the value of a 6, it becomes a 1.

name: Moon Witch

specialization.name: Moonbeam
specialization.text: Once per session, you can conjure a column of moonlight that illuminates the area within Close range until the end of the scene. While bathed in this moonlight, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Spellcast Rolls and can see through illusions.

specialization.name: Ire of Pale Light
specialization.text: When a _Hexed_ creature within Very Far range fails an attack, they must mark a Stress.
